title: Research / Project Poster and Public Technical Brief
purpose: Communicate a project or research result visually while preserving evidence status and technical accuracy.

sections.title: Title and Authors
sections.instruction: Specific title, authors, affiliations, project ID, date and contact/QR destination.

sections.title: Problem and Motivation
sections.instruction: One concise problem statement with source or project need.

sections.title: Objective and Contribution
sections.instruction: What is being investigated or built, and what contribution is claimed.

sections.title: Architecture / Method
sections.instruction: Use a readable system diagram with labels, units, legend and version.

sections.title: Results / Current Status
sections.instruction: Show measured, simulated, planned and placeholder results separately. Never imply a prototype exists if only simulated.

sections.title: Implications and Next Steps
sections.instruction: Bounded implications, limitations, next milestones and dependencies.

sections.title: References and Acknowledgements
sections.instruction: Cite key sources and funders; obtain permission for third-party images/logos.
